title: Show HN: Keeping faces and features consistent across 24 AI-driven comic pages
description: joonoo.art turns one photo into a comic book (or picture book) starring the people in it. Upload a photo of up to four people, say who's who, pick a story or write your own, choose a style, and in under a minute you see the cover and the story. The preview is free with no account. You pay only if you want the full book: starts at $4.99 for a PDF, or about $25 printed before shipping. Hi HN, I'm Saro, a granddad and CTO (formerly chief architect of Fidelity NetBenefits, and head of engineering at IDEMIA for TSA PreCheck). Reading picture books with my granddaughter last summer, I had the inspiration. I wanted her to be the hero of one. I launched it in August 2025 and got some orders and happy customers, but I held back on promoting it. The hard part was keeping the same face on every page. The models would hallucinate extra fingers or a different child halfway through, and vision models couldn't reliably catch it. Testing was almost entirely manual, so every small change took days.
